area: Geohash encode/decode and the base32 alphabet
alphabet_note: No 'a', 'i', 'l' or 'o' - they are visually confusable with 4, 1, 1 and 0.

prefix_chain.note: Encoding one coordinate at descending precision must yield a prefix chain.

invalid_geohashes.why: 'a' is not in the base32 alphabet

presence_precision.note: Precision <= 5 (region, province, city) may broadcast presence; 6 and finer (neighbourhood, block, building) must be refused by the builder itself, not by the call site.

vectors.name: canonical_reference
vectors.derivation: Computed with a python transcription of bitchat/Protocols/Geohash.swift (encode and decodeBounds), cross-checked against the canonical published geohash u4pruydqqvj for (57.64911, 10.40744).
vectors.note: The textbook geohash example (Jutland, Denmark). If this is wrong, everything is.
